facts.text: Keithley_2450 is a QCoDeS VisaInstrument whose docstring calls it a voltage source that behaves similarly to the K2400 series driver
The constructor takes name and address and passes terminator '\n' to VisaInstrument
rangev_source, rangev_sense, rangei_source and rangei_sense are Parameters with source/sense voltage and current range queries and '{:f}' setters
compliancev is a Parameter whose get_cmd is SOUR:CURR:VLIM:LEV? and whose set_cmd is SOUR:CURR:VLIM:LEV {:.16f}
compliancei is a Parameter whose get_cmd is SOUR:VOLT:ILIM:LEV? and whose set_cmd is SOUR:VOLT:ILIM:LEV {:.16f}
volt is a Parameter with unit V whose get_cmd is self._get_volt and set_cmd is self._set_volt; its docstring says a voltage read is an error while the output is off
curr is a Parameter with unit A whose get_cmd is self._get_current and set_cmd is self._set_current; its docstring says a current read is an error while the output is off
source is a Parameter with an Enum('VOLT', 'CURR') validator, get_cmd ':SOUR:FUNC?' and set_cmd self._set_mode_and_sense
sense is a Parameter with get_cmd ':SENS:FUNC?' and set_cmd ':SENS:FUNC "{:s}"'
output is a Parameter with get_cmd ':OUTP:STAT?' and set_cmd ':OUTP:STAT {:d}'
_get_volt raises when output() is 0, returns READ? when sense starts with "VOLT, and otherwise returns SOUR:VOLT? when source() is VOLT
_set_volt raises when output() is 0 and otherwise writes :SOUR:VOLT:LEV with eight decimals when source() is VOLT
_get_current raises when output() is 0, returns READ? when sense starts with "CURR, and otherwise returns SOUR:CURR? when source() is CURR
_set_current raises when output() is 0 and otherwise writes :SOUR:CURR:LEV with sixteen decimals when source() is CURR
_get_resistance raises when output() is 0 and returns READ? when sense is CURR with source VOLT or when source is CURR with sense VOLT
_set_mode_and_sense sets sense to CURR for VOLT and to VOLT for CURR, then writes :SOUR:FUNC
reset documents a return to GPIB defaults and cancellation of pending commands, and writes :*RST
_volt_parser returns field 0, _curr_parser returns field 1 and _resistance_parser returns field 0 divided by field 1 of a comma-separated reply
The constructor adds Parameters for ranges, compliance, voltage, current, source and sense mode, four-wire sense, output, NPLC and resistance, then calls connect_message

measures.description: Resistance from the voltage/current measurement pair; omitted while the output is off (the upstream method raises in that state)
measures.name: resistance

operator_required.name: voltage
operator_required.reason: the clone states no voltage range or limit for the Keithley 2450; the connected load and source range are an operator decision (Keithley_2450.py:49-60, 136-143)

operator_required.name: current
operator_required.reason: the clone states no current range or limit for the Keithley 2450; the connected load and source range are an operator decision (Keithley_2450.py:62-73, 164-171)

operator_required.name: compliancev
operator_required.reason: the clone states no voltage-compliance range for the Keithley 2450; the permitted voltage across the load is an operator decision (Keithley_2450.py:37-41)

operator_required.name: compliancei
operator_required.reason: the clone states no current-compliance range for the Keithley 2450; the permitted current through the load is an operator decision (Keithley_2450.py:43-47)

safe_state.description: source output off with :OUTP:STAT 0 (the command of the upstream output Parameter); the configured source level remains set but is not driven, and the e-stop latch refuses further actuation
